test_title: PYST 28: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the word-pair that best represents a similar relationship to the one expressed in the pair of words given below. (The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters/consonants/vowels in the word.)

Cheese : Milk
solution:
**Logic:** Product : Made from​

 
• **Cheese** is made with pasteurized or raw **milk**.

So,

 
• Option - (1) : Ketchup : Sauce

Ketchup fall under the category of sauce.

 
• Option - (2) : &l
